public.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
public.description: Water flows from a cell to horizontally or vertically adjacent cells of equal or lower height. The top and left borders touch the Pacific; the bottom and right borders touch the Atlantic. Return coordinates [row,column] that can reach both oceans, sorted by row then column. heights is rectangular, with 0 to 30 rows and columns and integer heights from 0 to 10000.
hints: Reverse the flow and search uphill from each ocean border.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Reverse reachability from each ocean identifies cells that drain to it. Intersect the two sets and emit row-major coordinates. O(rows times columns) time.
